notToBeConfusedWith.name: Anise seed
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A different plant with a similar liquorice note; FoodData Central carries anise seed but not star anise, and the two are not assumed interchangeable in composition here.

forms.label: Whole pod
forms.sourceNote: FoodData Central carries no record for star anise specifically, only the unrelated anise seed. No composition is claimed here rather than importing a different plant's figures; the pod is boiled or steeped and strained out in any case.
